title: Polarization, Maximal Concurrence, and Pure States in High-Energy Collisions
summary: We establish a quantitative relation between local spin polarization and quantum entanglement in two-qubit systems by mathematically proving a closed-form upper bound on the concurrence at fixed local polarization magnitudes. The bound shows how the maximal concurrence is jointly constrained by the two local polarizations. We further demonstrate that this bound is saturated by pure states in certain cases with identical polarizations.
